candidates_frozen.mechanism_basis: spectral candidate scoring subtracts 0.035*|candidate - time_bpm| and 0.025*|candidate - previous_bpm|; both attractors are themselves biased low, and CONTROL_SPECTRAL carries the most negative bias (-13.351010 bpm) of the three arms in the low-bias mechanism audit
candidates_frozen.allowed_change: weaken or remove the time/previous proximity penalties only; mmWave-derived quantities and frozen constants only; at most one registered variant
candidates_frozen.forbidden_change: ECG-informed selection; band change; new distance/quality/confidence gate; harmonic-fold tolerance change; fusion change; target or window change

candidates_frozen.mechanism_basis: anchor persistence uses next_previous = 0.8*previous + 0.2*fused gated at confidence>=0.12, and _smooth_track uses alpha = 0.20 + 0.30*clip(confidence,0,1) with a +/-7.0 bpm step limit; the anchor is also the tie-breaker when |time-spectral| > 10 bpm (31/100 development probes), so a low anchor favours the lower arm
candidates_frozen.allowed_change: anchor update dynamics only (faster escape from history, no low-confidence update, symmetric rate limit) using mmWave-derived quantities and existing constants
candidates_frozen.forbidden_change: ECG-decided anchor update; harmonic-fold tolerance change; fusion weighted-average change; target or window change
